AccessTokenClaims.title: AccessTokenClaims
AccessTokenClaims.description: Claims of a user access JWT (EdDSA, 15 minutes).

manual.description: When true the read marker is set to exactly this message, even backwards (Mark Unread). Without it the marker only moves forward.

mention_count.description: Unread mention count to keep after a manual ack (default 0).

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: A user activity as stored and fanned out. The gateway sanitises client activities (PRESENCE_UPDATE): only the fields below are kept, unknown fields (including `application_id`) are dropped, and a violation closes the socket with 4002.

type.description: ActivityType, 0..5. At most one activity per presence may be type 4 (custom status).

AdminGuild.title: AdminGuild
AdminGuild.description: A guild as listed in the admin portal.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: A user as listed in the admin portal.

AdminUserPage.title: AdminUserPage
AdminUserPage.description: GET /internal/v1/admin/users: a page of users, ordered by ID.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page; null at the end.

AllowedMentions.title: AllowedMentions
AllowedMentions.description: Controls which mentions in a message notify.

replied_user.description: Whether to mention the author of the replied-to message. Defaults to true; false suppresses the reply ping (no mention, no notification).

ApplicationAuthorization.title: ApplicationAuthorization
ApplicationAuthorization.description: One user's explicit consent to a bot installation. Contains no access token. Revoking consent does not remove the shared server bot.

permissions.description: Effective server permissions acknowledged at the last authorization, not a live permission grant.

ApplicationCommand.title: ApplicationCommand
ApplicationCommand.description: A slash, user or message command.

ApplicationCommandOption.title: ApplicationCommandOption
ApplicationCommandOption.description: A parameter or subcommand of an application command.

ApplicationCommandOptionChoice.title: ApplicationCommandOptionChoice
ApplicationCommandOptionChoice.description: A predefined choice of an option.

ApplicationCommandRequest.title: ApplicationCommandRequest
ApplicationCommandRequest.description: Create, overwrite or edit an application command.

Attachment.title: Attachment
Attachment.description: A file attached to a message.

flags.description: AttachmentFlags bit set; IS_SPOILER (8) marks a spoiler. When present, flags are authoritative: 0 clears a spoiler even for a SPOILER_ filename. Infer the filename prefix only when flags are absent.

AttachmentMetadataEdit.title: AttachmentMetadataEdit
AttachmentMetadataEdit.description: Updates metadata of one attachment already owned by this message. Omitted properties are unchanged; description null or blank clears alt text. Files, filenames, IDs and URLs are immutable. Only the author may edit attachment metadata.

description.description: Trimmed alt text; null or blank clears it.

flags.description: Only IS_SPOILER (8) is applied; other stored bits are preserved. Explicit 0 clears the spoiler even for a SPOILER_ filename.

AttachmentReference.title: AttachmentReference
AttachmentReference.description: An uploaded attachment referenced when creating or editing a message.

id.description: Attachment ID from POST /channels/{id}/attachments, or an index for existing ones.

description.description: Alt text shown to screen readers and as the image tooltip.

duration_secs.description: Duration of a recorded voice message in seconds.

waveform.description: Base64-encoded amplitude samples for a recorded voice message.

flags.description: AttachmentFlags bit set; IS_SPOILER (8) marks the file as a spoiler. A SPOILER_ filename prefix sets it too.

upload_filename.description: Pass back as `uploaded_filename` when creating the message.

AttachmentUploadFile.title: AttachmentUploadFile
AttachmentUploadFile.description: A file the client wants to upload.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: A page of a guild's audit log.

AuditLogEntryCreateEvent.title: AuditLogEntryCreateEvent
AuditLogEntryCreateEvent.description: AUDIT_LOG_ENTRY_CREATE dispatch: an audit log entry plus guild_id.

AuthResponse.title: AuthResponse
AuthResponse.description: Tokens returned by register, login and refresh.

AuthSession.title: AuthSession
AuthSession.description: A login session of the current user (one refresh-token family), as listed by GET /users/@me/sessions. Not to be confused with the gateway Session of SESSIONS_REPLACE.

id.description: Session ID; the `sid` claim of its access tokens.

client.description: The client that opened the session, derived from its User-Agent (for example `Desktop app` (the desktop client; clients show it with the brand name), `Firefox`).

os.description: Operating system derived from the User-Agent (for example `Windows`), or `Unknown`.

device_name.description: Name of the registered end-to-end encrypted device bound to the session, if any.

location.description: Approximate location (an ISO 3166-1 country code from the edge), or null when the edge does not provide one.

last_used_at.description: When the session last logged in or refreshed its tokens.

current.description: Whether this is the session making the request.

AuthorizationGuild.title: AuthorizationGuild
AuthorizationGuild.description: The server of a recorded bot authorization.

BackupCodesResponse.title: BackupCodesResponse
BackupCodesResponse.description: Backup codes. Codes are stored hashed, so plaintext appears only when generated or regenerated.

code.description: Plaintext code; omitted when only the consumed state is listed.

regenerate.description: Replaces every backup code and returns the new plaintext codes once.

BadgeVisibilityRequest.title: BadgeVisibilityRequest
BadgeVisibilityRequest.description: Change visibility of an existing badge grant owned by the caller.

BanMessagePurgeEvent.title: BanMessagePurgeEvent
BanMessagePurgeEvent.description: BAN_MESSAGE_PURGE bus event (discordy.guild.v1, routed by guild_id). A moderator banned a user with delete_message_seconds > 0 (PUT /guilds/{id}/bans/{uid}). The messages service deletes every message the user authored in the listed channels at or after since_ms (storage, search index, attachments, reactions, pins) and emits MESSAGE_DELETE_BULK per channel. The gateway ignores it and never dispatches it to clients. Replays are harmless: deleting already deleted messages is a no-op.

user_id.description: The banned user whose messages are purged.

channel_ids.description: The guild's text-capable channels and threads at ban time.

since_ms.description: Unix milliseconds: messages created at or after this instant are deleted (ban time minus delete_message_seconds).

BotInstallationRevision.title: BotInstallationRevision
BotInstallationRevision.description: Opaque installation precondition from the selected guild in GET /oauth2/authorize. Echo it unchanged in POST. It distinguishes an active installation, initial absence and absence after removal. Missing or null is invalid; a changed revision returns 409 without writes and requires a fresh preview and consent.

Call.title: Call
Call.description: A DM or group DM call: its voice states and the recipients still ringing for it. Carried by CALL_CREATE and CALL_UPDATE.

message_id.description: Always null: a call is not attached to a message.

region.description: Voice region the call is served from.

ringing.description: Recipients who have not joined or declined yet.

CallDeclinePayload.title: CallDeclinePayload
CallDeclinePayload.description: Op 25 CALL_DECLINE. Declines the call ringing in a DM channel; a no-op when the user is not ringing.

CallDeleteEvent.title: CallDeleteEvent
CallDeleteEvent.description: CALL_DELETE dispatch: the last participant left the DM call.

CallRingPayload.title: CallRingPayload
CallRingPayload.description: Op 26 CALL_RING. Rings the listed members of a DM channel for a call the sender is in.

Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: A guild channel, DM, group DM or thread. `delivery_mode` and `voice_region` are Discordy extras.

text_chat_enabled.description: Voice channels only: whether members can send messages to the channel chat. Defaults to true.

is_thread_member.description: Voics: whether the requesting user has joined this thread; omitted from shared events.

delivery_mode.description: Discordy: effective delivery mode. Always present on full channel objects.

voice_region.description: Discordy: per-channel voice region override; null uses the guild's voice_region.

ChannelAccess.title: ChannelAccess
ChannelAccess.description: GET /internal/v1/channels/{channel_id}/access/{user_id}. Current account eligibility is required: missing, disabled, pending-deletion or currently suspended users receive 403. Eligible bots and expired suspensions keep existing membership/permission behavior. No user session is required; fresh scheduled dispatch checks bypass caches and older in-flight requests. The response shape is unchanged, and the check/write race remains cross-service.

ChannelMention.title: ChannelMention
ChannelMention.description: A channel mentioned in a message.

message_notifications.description: 0 all messages, 1 only @mentions, 2 nothing. null inherits (the guild level for a channel override, the guild's default_message_notifications for the guild).

CreateApplicationRequest.title: CreateApplicationRequest
CreateApplicationRequest.description: POST /applications body. Creates the application and its bot user.

CreateDmRequest.title: CreateDmRequest
CreateDmRequest.description: POST /users/@me/channels body. One recipient creates a DM, several a group DM.

CreateGuildTemplateRequest.title: CreateGuildTemplateRequest
CreateGuildTemplateRequest.description: POST /guilds/{guild_id}/templates body. A guild has at most one template.

CreateMessageRequest.title: CreateMessageRequest
CreateMessageRequest.description: POST /channels/{id}/messages body. allowed_mentions.replied_user=false replies without pinging the replied-to author. Returns 409 (code 50160) when the effective delivery mode is not standard. A message_reference with type 1 (FORWARD) forwards message_id from channel_id: the caller needs VIEW_CHANNEL + READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY on the source and SEND_MESSAGES (+ ATTACH_FILES when the source has attachments) on the target; content is the optional added comment and may be empty. Forwards from or to non-standard (ephemeral/P2P) channels answer 409 (50160). A poll requires fresh SEND_POLLS in addition to normal send permissions. Its definition cannot be edited or forwarded; public bots use the same permissions, and internal/webhook/interaction poll creation is rejected. Poll-only messages are valid. Private delivery never stores polls.

tts.description: Read aloud by recipients with TTS enabled. Requires SEND_TTS_MESSAGES in addition to normal send permission; a disallowed true value returns 403. Stored and returned on messages and gateway events.

flags.description: MessageFlags bit set. SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS (4096) and IS_VOICE_MESSAGE (8192) are accepted; other user-supplied bits are dropped. Voice messages require SEND_VOICE_MESSAGES and exactly one attachment with duration_secs and waveform, without text, embeds or components.

CreateReportRequest.title: CreateReportRequest
CreateReportRequest.description: File a message, user or guild-channel report. A channel report requires current VIEW_CHANNEL access and snapshots only server-owned channel metadata, never messages, members or caller-supplied content. The guild target remains exclusive to the discovery listing report route. Duplicate open reports by the same reporter are accepted without creating another report; all targets share the report rate limit.

CreateScheduledMessageRequest.title: CreateScheduledMessageRequest
CreateScheduledMessageRequest.description: POST /channels/{channel_id}/messages/scheduled, user Bearer sessions only. New scheduled_at must be 1 minute..30 days ahead of the server clock. Quotas are 100 active intents per author and 25 per channel, including preparing/dispatching reservations; exhaustion returns 409/50035. Same author/request_id and original normalized request returns the current schedule (including terminal states) before rechecking time or current send access; different original content/channel conflicts. An incomplete acceptance returns 503, never a falsely accepted pending job.

DaveTransitionPayload.title: DaveTransitionPayload
DaveTransitionPayload.description: Voice ops 22 DAVE_EXECUTE_TRANSITION, 23 DAVE_TRANSITION_READY and 31 DAVE_MLS_INVALID_COMMIT.

DefaultReaction.title: DefaultReaction
DefaultReaction.description: Default reaction emoji of a forum channel.

DeliveryMode.title: DeliveryMode
DeliveryMode.description: Discordy message delivery mode. Strictness: standard (0) < ephemeral (1) < p2p (2).

DeliveryModeOverride.title: DeliveryModeOverride
DeliveryModeOverride.description: The caller's per-chat override and the resulting effective mode.

Device.title: Device
Device.description: A user device with its Ed25519 identity key (Discordy extra).

code.description: Current TOTP code or an unused backup code.

DiscoveryCategories.title: DiscoveryCategories
DiscoveryCategories.description: Category slugs a guild can be listed under.

approximate_presence_count.description: Online members; null when presence is unavailable.

DiscoveryPage.title: DiscoveryPage
DiscoveryPage.description: A page of discoverable servers, largest first.

E2eeEnvelopePayload.title: E2eeEnvelopePayload
E2eeEnvelopePayload.description: Op 20 E2EE_ENVELOPE. Client to gateway carries all recipients; gateway to client carries only the receiving device's entry.

attachments.description: Partial metadata edits of existing attachments. Unlisted files remain unchanged and an empty array does nothing. Unknown or duplicate attachment IDs reject the complete edit. This field cannot add or remove files.

EditScheduledMessageRequest.title: EditScheduledMessageRequest
EditScheduledMessageRequest.description: PATCH a pending schedule. The expected revision must match; at least one replacement is required. message replaces the whole draft, not individual fields. A new scheduled_at must be 1 minute..30 days ahead of the server clock. Fresh Standard send access is required; already-dispatching or terminal jobs conflict.

type.description: EmbedType: rich, link, image, video, gifv or article. Server-generated unfurls use every type but rich.

EmbedMedia.title: EmbedMedia
EmbedMedia.description: Embed image, thumbnail or video. For unfurled links `url` is the original remote address, `proxy_url` a signed media-proxy URL on the CDN host that clients load instead; a video of type text/html is an allow-listed player iframe.

Emoji.title: Emoji
Emoji.description: A custom or unicode emoji. Unicode emojis have a null id.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: REST error envelope with a Discord-style error code (see protocol.json rest.error_codes).

EventEnvelope.title: EventEnvelope
EventEnvelope.description: Redpanda event envelope. `data` is exactly the gateway DISPATCH payload for `type`.

guild_id.description: Set for guild fan-out (filtered by VIEW_CHANNEL and intents).

target_user_ids.description: Set for per-user delivery; null for guild fan-out.

ForumTag.title: ForumTag
ForumTag.description: A tag that can be applied to forum threads.

FriendSourceFlags.title: FriendSourceFlags
FriendSourceFlags.description: Sources allowed to initiate a new friend request. All defaults to true; when all is false, either matching enabled source permits the request. Existing friendships and pending requests remain usable; blocks take precedence.

GatewayFrame.title: GatewayFrame
GatewayFrame.description: Every gateway frame (both directions). `s` and `t` are only set on DISPATCH (op 0).

GatewayGuildState.title: GatewayGuildState
GatewayGuildState.description: Internal gateway seed. Thread membership state must not be sent to clients.

splash.description: Invite splash image hash (CDN path splashes/{guild_id}/{hash}), or null.

owner.description: True if the current user owns the guild.

system_channel_flags.description: Bit set of system message suppressions: 1 join notifications, 2 server boosts, 4 setup tips, 8 join reply buttons, 16 role subscription purchases, 32 their reply buttons. A set bit turns that message off; 0 keeps all on. Join messages are posted to system_channel_id when it is set and bit 1 is clear.

banner.description: Banner image hash (CDN path banners/{guild_id}/{hash}), or null.

voice_region.description: Discordy: voice region ID used to allocate voice nodes.

audit_log_enabled.description: Whether new audit entries are recorded. Audit-policy changes are always recorded. Existing entries remain readable within retention.

audit_log_retention_days.description: Retention for audit entries, including policy changes. Expired entries are excluded immediately and removed by the hourly retention job.

prune_admin_only.description: Discordy: when true, only administrators may prune inactive members.

Guild.title: Guild
Guild.description: A guild (server). `voice_region` is a Discordy extra.

splash.description: Invite splash image hash (CDN path splashes/{guild_id}/{hash}), or null.

owner.description: True if the current user owns the guild.

system_channel_flags.description: Bit set of system message suppressions: 1 join notifications, 2 server boosts, 4 setup tips, 8 join reply buttons, 16 role subscription purchases, 32 their reply buttons. audit_log_retention_days.description: Retention for audit entries, including policy changes. Expired entries are excluded immediately and removed by the hourly retention job.

prune_admin_only.description: Discordy: when true, only administrators may prune inactive members.

GuildApplicationCommandPermissions.title: GuildApplicationCommandPermissions
GuildApplicationCommandPermissions.description: Permissions of an application's command(s) in a guild.

id.description: Command ID, or the application ID for app-wide permissions.

GuildDiscoverySettings.title: GuildDiscoverySettings
GuildDiscoverySettings.description: A guild opt-in discovery listing and the rules that currently block listing it. Listing requires Community with configured rules and updates channels, a description of at least 10 characters, the configured minimum member count and guild age, and no age-restricted (nsfw) channel. enabled means opted in; blockers must also be empty for public visibility.

GuildFolder.title: GuildFolder
GuildFolder.description: One entry of the user's server rail (`user_settings.guild_folders`). The array order is the rail order. An entry with a `null` id is a plain, un-foldered server (exactly one guild id); an entry with an id is a folder.

id.description: Folder id chosen by the client (stable per user); null for a single un-foldered server.

GuildFull.title: GuildFull
GuildFull.description: A guild with its full state (GUILD_CREATE payload and the internal guild state endpoint).

splash.description: Invite splash image hash (CDN path splashes/{guild_id}/{hash}), or null.

owner.description: True if the current user owns the guild.

system_channel_flags.description: Bit set of system message suppressions: 1 join notifications, 2 server boosts, 4 setup tips, 8 join reply buttons, 16 role subscription purchases, 32 their reply buttons. A set bit turns that message off; 0 keeps all on. Join messages are posted to system_channel_id when it is set and bit 1 is clear.

banner.description: Banner image hash (CDN path banners/{guild_id}/{hash}), or null.

voice_region.description: Discordy: voice region ID used to allocate voice nodes.

audit_log_enabled.description: Whether new audit entries are recorded. Audit-policy changes are always recorded. Existing entries remain readable within retention.

audit_log_retention_days.description: Retention for audit entries, including policy changes. Expired entries are excluded immediately and removed by the hourly retention job.

GuildIntegration.title: GuildIntegration
GuildIntegration.description: An application whose bot is currently installed in this server.

permissions.description: Current effective server permissions, including the everyone role.

avatar.description: Server avatar hash; null uses the global avatar. CDN: /guilds/{guild_id}/users/{user_id}/avatars/{hash}.png (animated a_ hashes use .gif).

banner.description: Server banner hash; null uses the global banner. CDN: /guilds/{guild_id}/users/{user_id}/banners/{hash}.png (animated a_ hashes use .gif).

permissions.description: Total permissions in the interaction channel; only in interaction payloads.

bio.description: Server-specific About me; trimmed, null or blank restores the global bio.

GuildMemberEvent.title: GuildMemberEvent
GuildMemberEvent.description: GUILD_MEMBER_ADD / GUILD_MEMBER_UPDATE dispatch: a guild member plus guild_id.

avatar.description: Server avatar hash; null uses the global avatar. CDN: /guilds/{guild_id}/users/{user_id}/avatars/{hash}.png (animated a_ hashes use .gif).

banner.description: Server banner hash; null uses the global banner. CDN: /guilds/{guild_id}/users/{user_id}/banners/{hash}.png (animated a_ hashes use .gif).

permissions.description: Total permissions in the interaction channel; only in interaction payloads.

bio.description: Server-specific About me; trimmed, null or blank restores the global bio.

GuildNotificationSettings.title: GuildNotificationSettings
GuildNotificationSettings.description: The current user's notification settings for one guild, or for their DMs when guild_id is null (Discord's user guild settings). A channel override beats the guild level, which beats the guild's default_message_notifications. A muted guild mutes all its channels. Private to the user, synced to every session.

guild_id.description: null for direct messages and group DMs.

message_notifications.description: 0 all messages, 1 only @mentions, 2 nothing. null inherits (the guild level for a channel override, the guild's default_message_notifications for the guild).

channel_overrides.description: Only channels with a non-default override.

GuildTemplate.title: GuildTemplate
GuildTemplate.description: A server template: a shareable snapshot of a guild's roles and channels (Discord guild template). Built-in templates have a `code` starting with `builtin-`, no creator and a null `source_guild_id`.

is_dirty.description: Whether the source guild's current template-visible structure differs from the saved snapshot. Built-ins are always false. Syncing is explicit (`PUT /guilds/{guild_id}/templates/{code}`).

HeartbeatPayload.title: HeartbeatPayload
HeartbeatPayload.description: Op 1 HEARTBEAT: the last sequence number received, or null.

IdReservation.title: IdReservation
IdReservation.description: Committed exclusive-end millisecond interval for one process. Generation must fail outside this range or after end_ms-issued_at_ms measured monotonically from request START, including network time. Renewal must retain owner, worker and start and never shorten the end. Only a database commit grants a usable interval; failure grants nothing.

IdReservationRequest.title: IdReservationRequest
IdReservationRequest.description: One request per process owner. A fresh process always chooses a fresh UUID; owner IDs must never be shared or restored. The HTTP endpoint accepts service messages only; API uses its database adapter directly. Workers0 and64 remain permanently reserved for legacy issuers.

device_id.description: The identifying device. Null for bot sessions.

intents.description: Intent bitfield (intents.json). User sessions implicitly get all intents.

InstallParams.title: InstallParams
InstallParams.description: Default scopes and permissions for the bot invite.

Interaction.title: Interaction
Interaction.description: An interaction sent to a bot (INTERACTION_CREATE).

InteractionData.title: InteractionData
InteractionData.description: Interaction data for commands, components and modals.

InternalCreateMessageRequest.title: InternalCreateMessageRequest
InternalCreateMessageRequest.description: POST /internal/v1/channels/{id}/messages on messages. Bot, webhook, interaction and system messages; the user permission check is skipped, non-standard delivery modes still answer 409 (50160). `type` selects a system message: 1 RECIPIENT_ADD and 2 RECIPIENT_REMOVE (target_user_id), 3 CALL (call; author_id is the caller), 4 CHANNEL_NAME_CHANGE (content is the name), 5 CHANNEL_ICON_CHANGE, 6 CHANNEL_PINNED_MESSAGE (message_reference), 7 GUILD_MEMBER_JOIN (author_id is the member who joined; the caller picks the guild system channel), 18 THREAD_CREATED (thread_id, content is the thread name). Pinning through the public API already posts type 6 from messages.

author_id.description: The bot user, the webhook id for webhook posts, or the author of a system message.

tts.description: The calling service enforces SEND_TTS_MESSAGES. Stored for ordinary messages; system messages always have tts false.

flags.description: 64 (ephemeral) sends only to target_user_ids and stores nothing.

type.description: System message type (see description); omit or 0 for a normal message.

target_user_id.description: The user a type 1 or 2 message is about.

thread_id.description: The thread a type 18 message announces (required for type 18).

token.description: The raw Authorization header value or bare token.

InvalidSessionPayload.title: InvalidSessionPayload
InvalidSessionPayload.description: Op 9 INVALID_SESSION: whether the session can be resumed.

Invite.title: Invite
Invite.description: A guild or group DM invite.

InviteGuild.title: InviteGuild
InviteGuild.description: The partial guild an invite points to.

totp.description: TOTP code or backup code. When 2FA is enabled and this is absent the api answers 401 with code 60008 and a ticket for POST /auth/mfa/totp.

MediaSinkWantsPayload.title: MediaSinkWantsPayload
MediaSinkWantsPayload.description: Voice op 15 MEDIA_SINK_WANTS: keys are SSRCs as decimal strings, values the wanted quality 0-100. Selects the simulcast layer. Screen-share packets are opt-in: a subscriber receives a publisher's screen (the SSRC announced with `type: screen` in VIDEO) only after listing that SSRC with quality > 0; otherwise the SFU skips the packets. Opting in also makes the streamer's op 40 STREAM_VIEWERS list include the subscriber.

mention_here.description: Extension. With mention_everyone: the message pings with @here only (no @everyone), so only members who are online at send time are notified. Absent or false otherwise.

nonce.description: Client nonce used to resolve optimistic sends.

hit.description: Only in message search results: true for the matching message, absent for its context messages.

type.description: MessageType. 0 DEFAULT, 1 RECIPIENT_ADD, 2 RECIPIENT_REMOVE, 3 CALL (see call), 4 CHANNEL_NAME_CHANGE, 5 CHANNEL_ICON_CHANGE, 6 CHANNEL_PINNED_MESSAGE (message_reference is the pinned message), 7 GUILD_MEMBER_JOIN (author is the member who joined; posted in the guild system channel when one is set), 18 THREAD_CREATED (content is the thread name, message_reference.channel_id the thread), 19 REPLY. A forwarded message keeps type 0 and is identified by message_reference.type = 1 plus message_snapshots (Discord semantics).

message_snapshots.description: Present on messages with message_reference.type = 1 (FORWARD): a frozen copy of the forwarded message taken at forward time.

MessageAckEvent.title: MessageAckEvent
MessageAckEvent.description: MESSAGE_ACK dispatch (read-state sync across the user's devices).

read_state_version.description: Optional for legacy compatibility. Certified clients accept only a newer per-channel version, even for a backwards manual marker; this is independent of the legacy version field.

MessageCall.title: MessageCall
MessageCall.description: Payload of a type 3 (CALL) message. ended_timestamp is null while the call is running and is set when it ends.

participants.description: IDs of the users who took part in the call.

MessageComponent.title: MessageComponent
MessageComponent.description: A message component (action row, button, select menu, text input). Action rows nest components.

MessageEvent.title: MessageEvent
MessageEvent.description: MESSAGE_CREATE / MESSAGE_UPDATE dispatch: a message plus guild context.

mention_here.description: Extension. With mention_everyone: the message pings with @here only (no @everyone), so only members who are online at send time are notified. Absent or false otherwise.

nonce.description: Client nonce used to resolve optimistic sends.

hit.description: Only in message search results: true for the matching message, absent for its context messages.

type.description: MessageType. 0 DEFAULT, 1 RECIPIENT_ADD, 2 RECIPIENT_REMOVE, 3 CALL (see call), 4 CHANNEL_NAME_CHANGE, 5 CHANNEL_ICON_CHANGE, 6 CHANNEL_PINNED_MESSAGE (message_reference is the pinned message), 7 GUILD_MEMBER_JOIN (author is the member who joined; posted in the guild system channel when one is set), 18 THREAD_CREATED (content is the thread name, message_reference.channel_id the thread), 19 REPLY. A forwarded message keeps type 0 and is identified by message_reference.type = 1 plus message_snapshots (Discord semantics).

message_snapshots.description: Present on messages with message_reference.type = 1 (FORWARD): a frozen copy of the forwarded message taken at forward time.

MessageInteractionMetadata.title: MessageInteractionMetadata
MessageInteractionMetadata.description: The interaction a message responds to.

MessagePollVoteAddEvent.title: MessagePollVoteAddEvent

answer_ids.description: Complete post-mutation selection of user_id, including empty after the last removal.

MessagePollVoteAddEvent.description: Complete authoritative post-mutation counts and actor selection. Single-choice replacement can emit REMOVE and ADD with identical versions/results. Apply snapshots, never deltas.

MessagePollVoteRemoveEvent.title: MessagePollVoteRemoveEvent

answer_ids.description: Complete post-mutation selection of user_id, including empty after the last removal.

MessagePollVoteRemoveEvent.description: Complete authoritative post-mutation counts and actor selection. Single-choice replacement can emit REMOVE and ADD with identical versions/results. Apply snapshots, never deltas.

MessageReference.title: MessageReference
MessageReference.description: Reference to another message (reply, forward, crosspost). type 0 = DEFAULT (reply), 1 = FORWARD. A FORWARD reference requires message_id and channel_id; the server copies the source message into message_snapshots at send time and the reference is informational afterwards (the viewer may lack access to the source channel). On a PIN (type 6) message, message_id is the pinned message. On a THREAD_CREATED (type 18) message, message_id is absent and channel_id is the created thread.

total_results.description: Number of messages that match, across all pages.

messages.description: One group per hit: the matching message (hit = true) between its context messages, oldest first.

index_building.description: True while the search index is being (re)built from stored history; results may be incomplete.

MessageSnapshot.title: MessageSnapshot
MessageSnapshot.description: A frozen copy of a forwarded message. Attachments are re-referenced (same stored object, freshly signed URLs); the snapshot never changes when the source is edited or deleted.

MessagesAdminStats.title: MessagesAdminStats
MessagesAdminStats.description: GET /internal/v1/admin/stats on messages. Counts only, never content.

MfaLoginRequest.title: MfaLoginRequest
MfaLoginRequest.description: POST /auth/mfa/totp body: completes a login that answered 60008.

ticket.description: Single-use ticket returned with error 60008; valid for 5 minutes.

code.description: Six-digit TOTP code or a backup code such as `abcde-fghij`.

MfaRequiredResponse.title: MfaRequiredResponse
MfaRequiredResponse.description: 401 body of POST /auth/login when the password is right but 2FA is enabled and no code was sent.

ticket.description: Present to /auth/mfa/totp with a TOTP/recovery code or to /auth/mfa/webauthn/start.

methods.description: Registered factors available for this ticket; older servers may omit it.

ModifyChannelRequest.title: ModifyChannelRequest
ModifyChannelRequest.description: PATCH /channels/{id} body (partial). Changing delivery_mode requires MANAGE_CHANNELS.

text_chat_enabled.description: Voice channels only. Managers with MANAGE_CHANNELS switch the channel chat on or off.

ModifyCurrentUserRequest.title: ModifyCurrentUserRequest
ModifyCurrentUserRequest.description: PATCH /users/@me body. `username`, `email` and `new_password` require the current `password`; an email change takes effect once the new address is verified.

bio.description: About me text; null or blank clears it. Trimmed, at most 300 characters.

banner.description: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP data URI; maximum 10 MiB decoded. Null removes the banner; omission retains it.

password.description: Current password; required with username, email or new_password.

pronouns.description: Optional public pronouns; trimmed, null or blank clears them. At most 40 Unicode characters.

theme_colors.description: Exactly two RGB colors (0..16777215) for the profile theme. Null resets to the default theme.

ModifyGuildNotificationSettingsRequest.title: ModifyGuildNotificationSettingsRequest
ModifyGuildNotificationSettingsRequest.description: PATCH /users/@me/guilds/{guild_id|@me}/settings body (partial). Muting with muted true and no mute_config mutes until turned off; muted false clears the mute. channel_overrides entries are merged per channel_id (omitted fields keep their value); an entry left with no level and no mute is deleted.

message_notifications.description: 0 all, 1 mentions, 2 nothing; null or 3 inherits.

selected_time_window.description: Seconds from now (900, 3600, 10800, 28800, 86400, ...), or -1 for until turned off. Ignored when end_time is set.

message_notifications.description: 0 all, 1 mentions, 2 nothing; null or 3 inherits.

selected_time_window.description: Seconds from now (900, 3600, 10800, 28800, 86400, ...), or -1 for until turned off. Ignored when end_time is set.

ModifyGuildRequest.title: ModifyGuildRequest
ModifyGuildRequest.description: PATCH /guilds/{id} body (partial). `voice_region` is a Discordy extra.

features.description: MANAGE_GUILD. [] disables Community, clears its channels and removes the discovery listing. [COMMUNITY] enables it and requires rules_channel_id and public_updates_channel_id. Both must be non-NSFW standard text or announcement channels in this guild. Omission retains the current Community setting.

banner.description: Image data URI (png, jpeg, gif or webp, at most 10 MiB) to set the banner; null removes it.

splash.description: Image data URI (png, jpeg, gif or webp, at most 10 MiB) to set the invite splash; null removes it.

system_channel_flags.description: Bit set of system message suppressions: 1 join notifications, 2 server boosts, 4 setup tips, 8 join reply buttons, 16 role subscription purchases, 32 their reply buttons. A set bit turns that message off; 0 keeps all on. Join messages are posted to system_channel_id when it is set and bit 1 is clear.

rules_channel_id.description: Community rules channel. Required when enabling Community; cannot be cleared while Community remains enabled. May equal public_updates_channel_id.

public_updates_channel_id.description: Community updates channel. Required when enabling Community; cannot be cleared while Community remains enabled. May equal rules_channel_id.

audit_log_enabled.description: Owner or ADMINISTRATOR only. Disabling suppresses new audit entries and dispatches, except audit-policy changes themselves.

audit_log_retention_days.description: Owner or ADMINISTRATOR only. Existing entries older than this window become unreadable immediately and are physically removed by the hourly retention job.

prune_admin_only.description: Discordy: restrict member pruning to administrators. Needs MANAGE_GUILD.

ModifyMemberRequest.title: ModifyMemberRequest
ModifyMemberRequest.description: PATCH /guilds/{id}/members/{uid} body. Avatar, banner and bio may be changed only by the member themself, even if the caller manages the guild. Nickname permissions are unchanged. Omission preserves each field; null restores its global fallback. Emits GUILD_MEMBER_UPDATE.

channel_id.description: Move to a voice channel of the guild, or null to disconnect. Needs MOVE_MEMBERS (and CONNECT on the target channel); ignored when the member is not in voice.

bio.description: Server-specific About me; trimmed, null or blank restores the global bio.

avatar.description: Self-only server avatar. PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP data URI; maximum 10 MiB decoded. Null restores the global image.

banner.description: Self-only server banner. PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP data URI; maximum 10 MiB decoded. Null restores the global image.

e2ee_calls_default.description: When true, every call the user starts or joins is end-to-end encrypted (DMs, group DMs, voice channels, Go Live). A call is E2EE for everyone when any participant has this set.

guild_folders.description: The user's server rail in order, with folders. Synced across devices.

guild_positions.description: Flat server order (legacy mirror of guild_folders).

pinned_dm_channel_ids.description: DM and group DM channels pinned to the top of the DM list (at most 5), most recently pinned last. Synced across devices.

pinned_channel_ids.description: Personal pinned channels per server, at most 10 per server (guild id to channel ids, most recently pinned last), shown at the top of that server's channel list. Visible only to the user. Synced across devices.

preferences.description: Merged key by key into the stored preferences.

friend_source_flags.description: Partial friend-request source update; omitted flags retain their values.

ModifyVanityUrlRequest.title: ModifyVanityUrlRequest
ModifyVanityUrlRequest.description: Requires MANAGE_GUILD. Set a permanent invitation code or remove it with null. Codes cannot conflict with ordinary invites, ignoring case.

MuteConfig.title: MuteConfig
MuteConfig.description: When a mute ends. end_time null means until turned off; an end_time in the past means the mute has expired and is ignored.

NotificationRecipient.title: NotificationRecipient
NotificationRecipient.description: A current channel viewer and their resolved notification policy. Independent of push-token ownership; includes desktop-only users. These are policy facts, not an instruction to increment a badge for every message.

online.description: Whether a live gateway session was observed for this page. This is not proof that a mobile app is in the foreground.

level.description: Resolved channel, parent, guild or server-default level: 0 all messages, 1 mentions, 2 nothing.

muted.description: A guild, channel or parent mute is active at evaluated_at. An end_time equal to or before that time is expired.

NotificationRecipientPage.title: NotificationRecipientPage
NotificationRecipientPage.description: A bounded page of currently permitted Standard-channel recipients, excluding author_id. Permissions and preferences are resolved per request, not a historical or cross-page snapshot. A filtered page may be empty with a non-null next_after; continue until null. Private delivery modes return no recipients and no continuation.

next_after.description: Last examined candidate ID when more candidates remain. May refer to an excluded author or hidden member. Pass as after to continue.

OAuth2AuthorizeInfo.title: OAuth2AuthorizeInfo
OAuth2AuthorizeInfo.description: Bot-install consent information. Only bot and applications.commands are supported.

permissions.description: Permissions requested by the invite URL.

OAuth2AuthorizeRequest.title: OAuth2AuthorizeRequest
OAuth2AuthorizeRequest.description: Install a bot and record explicit consent, or acknowledge the current permissions of an existing installation. Unsupported scopes, permission bits and authorization-code parameters are rejected.

permissions.description: For a new installation, requested bot role permissions. For an existing installation, the exact effective bot_permissions displayed by GET /oauth2/authorize; a changed set returns 409 and requires a fresh review.

scope.description: Space-separated bot and optionally applications.commands. bot is required.

location.description: Relative in-app /channels/{guild_id} destination. Never an externally supplied redirect URI.

OAuth2Guild.title: OAuth2Guild
OAuth2Guild.description: A guild the user can add the bot to.

bot_permissions.description: Null if the bot is absent; otherwise its current effective permissions. Reauthorization acknowledges these permissions without changing the shared installation.

P2pSignalPayload.title: P2pSignalPayload
P2pSignalPayload.description: Op 22 P2P_SIGNAL. Relayed only, never persisted.

identity_sig_b64.description: Signature over the DTLS fingerprint by the sender's device identity key.

PartialUser.title: PartialUser
PartialUser.description: A user reference that only guarantees the ID (presence updates, audit logs).

Passkey.title: Passkey
Passkey.description: Registered second factor metadata. Credential public keys and challenges are never included.

PasskeyDeleteRequest.title: PasskeyDeleteRequest
PasskeyDeleteRequest.description: Removing a passkey needs the password and a valid TOTP or one-time recovery code. Removing the last factor turns MFA off.

PasskeyRegisterFinishRequest.title: PasskeyRegisterFinishRequest
PasskeyRegisterFinishRequest.description: Finish the registration using navigator.credentials.create, serializing binary fields as unpadded base64url.

PasskeyRegisterResponse.title: PasskeyRegisterResponse
PasskeyRegisterResponse.description: The enrolled passkey. First-factor enrollment generates recovery codes; existing codes are retained when another factor is added.

code.description: Plaintext code; omitted when only the consumed state is listed.

PasskeyRegisterStartRequest.title: PasskeyRegisterStartRequest
PasskeyRegisterStartRequest.description: Reauthenticate with the password before creating a passkey registration challenge.

PasskeyRenameRequest.title: PasskeyRenameRequest
PasskeyRenameRequest.description: Rename one of the authenticated user's passkeys. The name is trimmed and must contain 1–64 Unicode characters without control characters. Credential material and MFA state are unchanged.

PasswordConfirmationRequest.title: PasswordConfirmationRequest
PasswordConfirmationRequest.description: Body of POST /users/@me/disable, /users/@me/delete and /users/@me/mfa/totp/enable: the current password re-authenticates the caller.

PermissionBitset.title: PermissionBitset
PermissionBitset.description: A 64-bit permission bitfield serialized as a decimal string. Bit values are listed in permissions.json.

PermissionOverwrite.title: PermissionOverwrite
PermissionOverwrite.description: A channel permission overwrite for a role or member.

Poll.title: Poll
Poll.description: A Standard message poll. Absent results mean unknown. The immutable definition is never reset by a message edit.

me_voted.description: Absent in public events: unknown, not false.

PollCreate.title: PollCreate
PollCreate.description: Immutable poll definition for a Standard public message. Answer IDs and expiry are server assigned. Unsupported internal/webhook/interaction, scheduled and forward creation is rejected.

PollEmoji.title: PollEmoji
PollEmoji.description: Unicode emoji decoration only. Custom IDs are rejected until fresh custom-emoji authorization exists. Runtime also rejects whitespace and ASCII-only names.

PollMedia.title: PollMedia
PollMedia.description: An answer label, optionally decorated with a Unicode emoji.

PollQuestion.title: PollQuestion
PollQuestion.description: Plain text. Does not produce mentions or embeds.

PollResults.title: PollResults

answer_counts.description: Complete counts, one per immutable answer, including zeros. Unique IDs are checked by the producer.

vote_version.description: Present only when the current viewer is known. Never overwrite a newer viewer version with absent or older facts.

PollResults.description: Authoritative counts. Replace by results version; never add/subtract event deltas.

PollSnapshot.title: PollSnapshot
PollSnapshot.description: Viewer-authorized poll snapshot. GET is side-effect-free. Refresh visible polls on foreground/reconnect to repair missed publication.

PollVersion.title: PollVersion
PollVersion.description: Monotonic decimal revision, bounded by signed 64-bit storage at runtime. Results versions are scoped to a poll; vote versions to a poll and voter. Compare numerically; exhaustion fails closed.

me_voted.description: Absent in public events: unknown, not false.

PollViewerResults.title: PollViewerResults

answer_counts.description: Complete counts, one per immutable answer, including zeros. Unique IDs are checked by the producer.

vote_version.description: Present only when the current viewer is known. Never overwrite a newer viewer version with absent or older facts.

PollViewerResults.description: Authenticated snapshot with explicit selection for every answer and the viewer revision, including zero for a first-time viewer.

PollVoteRequest.title: PollVoteRequest
PollVoteRequest.description: The revision of your own vote, not the global results. An already-satisfied retry is a no-op; any stale request that changes your selection conflicts.

PresenceUpdatePayload.title: PresenceUpdatePayload
PresenceUpdatePayload.description: Op 3 PRESENCE_UPDATE (also the optional `presence` of IDENTIFY). `activities` are sanitised by the gateway: at most 5 entries and at most one of type 4 (custom status); text fields at most 128 characters, `url` at most 512; unknown fields are dropped. Any violation closes the socket with 4002 DECODE_ERROR.

activities.description: At most 5 activities, at most one with type 4. Violations close the socket with 4002.

background.description: Mobile lifecycle hint. True means this app entered the background; false (also the default when omitted) means foreground. Only authenticated mobile user sessions may retain their effective presence after transport suspension, for a bounded server-configured lease (24 hours by default). This does not prove the app is still running. Logout or session revocation removes it immediately, and foreground/resume cancels the lease. Clients send their chosen effective status: automatic background idle must not replace explicitly selected Online, Idle, DND or Invisible. Desktop and bot sessions do not gain a background lease.

since.description: Unix ms since the client went idle.

ProbeVoiceTokenClaims.title: ProbeVoiceTokenClaims
ProbeVoiceTokenClaims.description: Mandatory additional validation for a voice token signed with VOICE_PROBE_TOKEN_SECRET and purpose=probe. The call-signing key must not authorize probe tokens, nor the probe key call tokens. The live node lease must match, video must be disabled, and the server derives an isolated room from node_lease plus probe_id. Never authorize an ordinary user room from a probe token's srv/chn values.

srv.description: guild_id, or the DM channel_id for DM calls.

ProfileBadge.title: ProfileBadge
ProfileBadge.description: An earned badge and the owner-selected visibility.

PruneResult.title: PruneResult
PruneResult.description: GET /guilds/{id}/prune (members that would be removed) and POST /guilds/{id}/prune (members removed).

PublicDevice.title: PublicDevice
PublicDevice.description: A device's public identity, as listed by GET /users/{id}/devices.

PutNoteRequest.title: PutNoteRequest
PutNoteRequest.description: PUT /users/@me/notes/{user_id} body. An empty or missing note deletes the note.

PutRelationshipRequest.title: PutRelationshipRequest
PutRelationshipRequest.description: PUT /users/@me/relationships/{id} body. Omit type to send or accept a friend request.

Reaction.title: Reaction
Reaction.description: Reactions of one emoji on a message.

ReadState.title: ReadState
ReadState.description: One channel's read snapshot. Version is optional only for legacy servers; a certified response requires it on every entry.

ReadStateSyncEvent.title: ReadStateSyncEvent
ReadStateSyncEvent.description: Certified snapshot fetched during resume, after subscription and before RESUMED. Merge each channel by version with replayed updates; an absent channel is not a deletion. An equal version may restore the known authoritative snapshot over local optimistic state, but conflicting equal-version data and older versions are ignored. A fresh READY, not this event, starts a new version history.

ReadStateUpdateEvent.title: ReadStateUpdateEvent
ReadStateUpdateEvent.description: Full authoritative snapshot targeted only to the owning user's sessions. Accept only a newer channel version; duplicate and reordered events do not add counts. Message IDs do not describe count membership.

ReadStateVersion.title: ReadStateVersion
ReadStateVersion.description: Per-user/channel authoritative mutation sequence, encoded as a decimal string to avoid JavaScript rounding. Range 0..9223372036854775807; producers fail closed at exhaustion. Compare numerically within a session, never against message IDs or gateway sequence.

ReadyEvent.title: ReadyEvent
ReadyEvent.description: READY: the internal ready state plus session details.

user_guild_settings.description: Stored notification settings of the user's guilds and DMs (guild_id null); guilds without a row use the defaults.

notes.description: The user's private notes keyed by the noted user's id.

read_state_versioned.description: Present only after successful certified messages hydration. Standard counts use authoritative snapshots rather than CREATE increments; private decrypted traffic stays local. Absent means legacy behavior.

request_id.description: Optional random UUID saved durably with the current refresh token before sending. Retrying this exact pair for up to five minutes recovers its immediate unused, unexpired successor in a live session without extending expiry. Keep the UUID until successor credentials are saved, then generate a new UUID for the next rotation. Omission retains strict single-use rotation.

ReportListingRequest.title: ReportListingRequest
ReportListingRequest.description: Report a currently discoverable guild listing. The server captures only the public listing as evidence. Shares the reporter's 10-per-hour report limit; an existing open report from the same user is idempotent. Filing a report does not automatically remove a listing.

ResetBotTokenResponse.title: ResetBotTokenResponse
ResetBotTokenResponse.description: POST /applications/{id}/bot/reset-token response. The token is shown once.

ResolvedData.title: ResolvedData
ResolvedData.description: Objects referenced by an interaction, keyed by ID.

ScheduledMessage.title: ScheduledMessage
ScheduledMessage.description: Author-private durable schedule. A sent outcome certifies storage, not event/push delivery. An unknown outcome may have stored a message; its selected ID is not proof of delivery. Terminal/unknown states clear the draft and release active quota exactly once. Only the original dispatch attempt may later certify unknown as sent; automatic redispatch is forbidden. Pre-dispatch dependency retries expire after 24 hours overdue. Unresolved dispatches become eligible for unknown recovery after 2 minutes; this is not a deadline during an outage.

ScheduledMessageDraft.title: ScheduledMessageDraft
ScheduledMessageDraft.description: Initial scheduling surface: Standard text, optional TTS/reply and reply-ping/silent options. Full replacement when edited. Attachment, embed, component and forward drafts are unsupported and must not be silently dropped. Normal send permissions and mention policy are re-evaluated at dispatch.

tts.description: Requires SEND_TTS_MESSAGES at acceptance/edit and dispatch.

reply_to.description: Same-channel reply target, revalidated at dispatch.

replied_user.description: Whether a reply mentions its target author; ignored when reply_to is absent.

silent.description: Maps to SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS (4096), with the existing silent-message semantics.

ScheduledMessageId.title: ScheduledMessageId
ScheduledMessageId.description: Client-generated cryptographically random lowercase UUIDv4. The author/key pair identifies one durable schedule intent across channels. Preserve and replay the exact original request after response loss.

ScheduledMessageList.title: ScheduledMessageList
ScheduledMessageList.description: Author/channel page in schedule UUID order, including active/unknown jobs and terminal jobs from the last seven days. Follow non-null next_after even after an empty page filtered by journal state. Exact author lookup retains content-free idempotency records after list expiry.

ScheduledMessageRevision.title: ScheduledMessageRevision
ScheduledMessageRevision.description: Monotonic schedule revision. Compare only within the same author/schedule; unrelated to read-state versions or gateway sequence. Mutation fails closed at exhaustion.

SelectOption.title: SelectOption
SelectOption.description: An option of a string select menu.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: An active gateway session of the current user.

SessionClientInfo.title: SessionClientInfo
SessionClientInfo.description: The client that opened the session.

SessionDescriptionPayload.title: SessionDescriptionPayload
SessionDescriptionPayload.description: Voice op 4 SESSION_DESCRIPTION. The client synthesises the remote SDP from it.

SessionRevokeEvent.title: SessionRevokeEvent
SessionRevokeEvent.description: SESSION_REVOKE bus event (discordy.user.v1, routed to the user in target_user_ids). Login sessions were revoked (DELETE /users/@me/sessions/{id}, POST /users/@me/sessions/logout-all). The gateway closes every live connection whose authenticated session id is listed, with close code 4004, and never dispatches it to clients.

SessionsReplaceEvent.title: SessionsReplaceEvent
SessionsReplaceEvent.description: SESSIONS_REPLACE dispatch: every active session of the user.

SfuCloseSession.title: SfuCloseSession
SfuCloseSession.description: SFU control command: close a media session.

SfuCreateSession.title: SfuCreateSession
SfuCreateSession.description: SFU control command (NDJSON line): create or rebuild a media session.

SfuSessionCreated.title: SfuSessionCreated
SfuSessionCreated.description: SFU control event: reply to create_session.

SfuSetSinkWants.title: SfuSetSinkWants
SfuSetSinkWants.description: SFU control command: update simulcast layer preferences.

SfuSpeaking.title: SfuSpeaking
SfuSpeaking.description: SFU control event: voice activity on an SSRC.

SfuStats.title: SfuStats
SfuStats.description: SFU control event: periodic load statistics.

SfuStreamViewers.title: SfuStreamViewers
SfuStreamViewers.description: SFU control event: the set of subscribers opted in to a screen share changed. Carries the full viewer list; signalling forwards it to the streamer as voice op 40.

viewers.description: User ids of every opted-in viewer.

Snowflake.title: Snowflake
Snowflake.description: A 64-bit Discordy Snowflake ID serialized as a decimal string (42 bits ms since 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, 10 bits worker, 12 bits sequence).

StreamViewersPayload.title: StreamViewersPayload
StreamViewersPayload.description: Voice op 40 STREAM_VIEWERS. Server to streamer only: the users currently watching the streamer's screen share. Always the full list (empty means nobody); it is re-sent whenever the set changes.

TemplateChannel.title: TemplateChannel
TemplateChannel.description: A channel of a template. `id` and `parent_id` are template-local ids, numbered from 1.

type.description: ChannelType: 0 text, 2 voice, 4 category, 5 announcement, 13 stage, 15 forum.

TemplateOverwrite.title: TemplateOverwrite
TemplateOverwrite.description: A role permission overwrite of a template channel. `id` is a template-local role id (0 is @everyone); member overwrites are never captured.

TemplateRole.title: TemplateRole
TemplateRole.description: A role of a template. `id` is template-local: 0 is @everyone, other roles are numbered from 1 in ascending position.

TemplateSourceGuild.title: TemplateSourceGuild
TemplateSourceGuild.description: The structure a template creates: guild settings, roles and channels with template-local ids.

ThreadMember.title: ThreadMember
ThreadMember.description: A user's membership of a thread.

ThreadMemberTarget.title: ThreadMemberTarget
ThreadMemberTarget.description: A thread member's Snowflake or @me for the authenticated user.

ThreadMembersUpdate.title: ThreadMembersUpdate
ThreadMembersUpdate.description: A thread membership change. The underscore-prefixed fields are internal bus state and must never be dispatched to clients.

TotpEnrollmentResponse.title: TotpEnrollmentResponse
TotpEnrollmentResponse.description: A pending TOTP secret; 2FA is not active until POST /users/@me/mfa/totp/verify.

otpauth_uri.description: `otpauth://totp/...` URI to render as a QR code.

UnavailableGuild.title: UnavailableGuild
UnavailableGuild.description: A guild that is unavailable or that the user left.

UpdateCallRequest.title: UpdateCallRequest
UpdateCallRequest.description: PATCH /internal/v1/channels/{id}/messages/{id}/call on messages. Records the end of a call on its type 3 message; omitted fields stay unchanged. Answers the updated Message and publishes MESSAGE_UPDATE. 400 when the message is not a call.

UpdateGuildDiscoveryRequest.title: UpdateGuildDiscoveryRequest
UpdateGuildDiscoveryRequest.description: PUT /guilds/{guild_id}/discovery body. `enabled: false` removes the listing; otherwise `category` is required.

UsageTickEvent.title: UsageTickEvent
UsageTickEvent.description: USAGE_TICK counter (discordy.telemetry.v1) consumed by the admin aggregator. Counts only, never content.

User.title: User
User.description: A Discordy user (Discord v10 User object).

bio.description: Profile About me text, at most 300 characters.

email.description: Only returned for the current user.

pronouns.description: Optional public pronouns; trimmed, null or blank clears them. At most 40 Unicode characters.

theme_colors.description: Exactly two RGB colors (0..16777215) for the profile theme. Null resets to the default theme.

UserNote.title: UserNote
UserNote.description: A private note the current user wrote about another user. Visible only to its author.

note_user_id.description: The user the note is about.

UserNoteUpdateEvent.title: UserNoteUpdateEvent
UserNoteUpdateEvent.description: USER_NOTE_UPDATE dispatch, sent to the author's sessions only. An empty note means the note was removed.

id.description: The user the note is about.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Client preferences that follow the account across devices (client#123). Sparse: a key is present only once the user (or a first-run migration) set it; clients fall back to their defaults for missing keys. As a PATCH value the object is merged key by key. Device-specific settings (audio and video devices, volumes, keybinds, window state, desktop notification toggle, taskbar flash) are not stored here.

default_guilds_restricted.description: Default restriction on new guild-related DMs; missing means false.

guild_dm_restrictions.description: Per-server override of the default. PATCH merges entries, and null removes an override; stored responses contain booleans. Friends and existing one-to-one DMs are exempt. Any permissive shared server permits initiation; no shared server retains existing behavior.

hide_age_restricted_channels.description: Hide age-restricted channels and block their content in clients. Missing means false: channels remain visible but require explicit confirmation per channel and session before content loads. This is a content preference, not verified age or server authorization.

link_previews.description: Show previews (embeds) of links in messages.

saturation.description: Colour saturation of the interface, 1 is full colour (accessibility).

role_colors.description: How role colours show on member names: tint the name, a dot beside it, or not at all.

message_spacing.description: Space in pixels between message groups.

high_contrast.description: Increase contrast of text and borders.

animate_gifs.description: Play GIFs automatically; when off they play on hover.

tts_read_aloud.description: Allow the /tts command and read text-to-speech messages aloud.

tts_rate.description: Speech rate of text-to-speech playback, 1 is normal.

sound_toggles.description: Per-sound switches under notify_sounds; a missing entry means on.

skin_tone.description: Skin tone modifier of the emoji picker; empty for the default.

recent_reactions.description: Recently used reaction emoji, most recent first.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: GET /users/{id}/profile: a user plus what the caller and that user have in common (mutual servers and mutual friends).

mutual_guilds.description: Servers both users are members of. nick is the target user's nickname there.

mutual_friends.description: Users who are friends of both the caller and the target.

UserReadStates.title: UserReadStates
UserReadStates.description: Messages-owned read-state snapshots. Header X-Read-State-Versioned: 1 certifies that every entry is versioned and the writer publishes authoritative updates, including for an empty array. Gateway must reject malformed certified entries and duplicate channel IDs.

UserReadyState.title: UserReadyState
UserReadyState.description: GET /internal/v1/users/{user_id}/ready: the state used to build READY.

user_guild_settings.description: Stored notification settings of the user's guilds and DMs (guild_id null); guilds without a row use the defaults.

notes.description: The user's private notes keyed by the noted user's id.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Account-wide settings of the current user. `default_delivery_mode` is a Discordy extra.

default_delivery_mode.description: Default delivery mode for DMs and group DMs without a per-chat override.

e2ee_calls_default.description: When true, every call the user starts or joins is end-to-end encrypted (DMs, group DMs, voice channels, Go Live). A call is E2EE for everyone when any participant has this set.

guild_folders.description: The user's server rail in order, with folders. Synced across devices.

pinned_dm_channel_ids.description: DM and group DM channels pinned to the top of the DM list (at most 5), most recently pinned last. Synced across devices.

pinned_channel_ids.description: Personal pinned channels per server, at most 10 per server (guild id to channel ids, most recently pinned last), shown at the top of that server's channel list. Visible only to the user. Synced across devices.

guild_positions.description: Flat server order (legacy mirror of guild_folders).

preferences.description: Synced client preferences (appearance, chat, notification sounds, emoji). Sparse.

VanityUrl.title: VanityUrl
VanityUrl.description: A guild's permanent invitation. Codes are unique across guilds, case-insensitive and returned lowercase. Resolves through /invites/{code} while the guild has an @everyone-visible text channel.

uses.description: Successful joins through this code. Existing membership does not increment it. Renaming the code resets this count.

user_id.description: Set by the server when relaying another user's announcement.

VoiceCodec.title: VoiceCodec
VoiceCodec.description: A codec offered by the client. Shipped desktop and mobile clients prefer VP8 for interoperable camera and screen video. The SFU forwards encoded payloads unchanged; peers must negotiate a common video codec. Older desktop builds preferring VP9 require an update for mobile video.

VoiceHeartbeatPayload.title: VoiceHeartbeatPayload
VoiceHeartbeatPayload.description: Voice op 3 HEARTBEAT and op 6 HEARTBEAT_ACK.

server_id.description: guild_id, or the DM channel_id for DM calls.

VoiceMemberMoveEvent.title: VoiceMemberMoveEvent
VoiceMemberMoveEvent.description: VOICE_MEMBER_MOVE bus event (discordy.guild.v1, routed by guild_id). A moderator moved a member to another voice channel or disconnected them (PATCH /guilds/{id}/members/{uid} with channel_id). The gateway applies it to the member's live voice session and never dispatches it to clients; it is ignored when the member is not in voice. Clients observe the result as VOICE_STATE_UPDATE plus, for a move, VOICE_SERVER_UPDATE with a token for the new channel.

channel_id.description: The voice channel to move the member to, or null to disconnect them.

VoiceNodeBlacklist.title: VoiceNodeBlacklist
VoiceNodeBlacklist.description: Persistent operator exclusion at /discordy/voice/blacklist/nodes/<node_id> or /discordy/voice/blacklist/regions/<region>. Key presence excludes new allocations regardless of probe success, including malformed values. Probers must never modify or delete it. Clearing the exact key removes only the manual exclusion; required health, draining and identity checks still apply. Existing calls continue.

VoiceNodeHealth.title: VoiceNodeHealth
VoiceNodeHealth.description: Leased etcd value at /discordy/voice/health/<node_id>. A writer must atomically compare both the node registration lease and its exclusive /discordy/voice/probers/<node_id> claim before writing. The health value shares the prober claim's lease, expiring within two probe intervals if not renewed. Readers match registration_lease; a previous incarnation's result must never authorize or exclude its successor.

status.description: Unknown until M consecutive passes or N consecutive failures. Defaults N=2, M=2. A healthy node survives fewer than N failures; an unhealthy node remains excluded until M passes.

checked_at_ms.description: Unix time for diagnostics only; freshness follows the etcd lease, not synchronized wall clocks.

VoiceNodeRegistration.title: VoiceNodeRegistration
VoiceNodeRegistration.description: etcd value at `/discordy/voice/nodes/<region>/<node_id>` (10 s lease, refreshed every 3 s).

probe_required.description: When true, new allocation requires a fresh healthy probe record for this registration's etcd lease. Omitted/false preserves legacy rollout behavior; an explicit matching unhealthy result or manual blacklist still excludes the node.

VoiceStateUpdatePayload.title: VoiceStateUpdatePayload
VoiceStateUpdatePayload.description: Op 4 VOICE_STATE_UPDATE. guild_id is null for DM calls; channel_id null disconnects.

VoiceTokenClaims.title: VoiceTokenClaims
VoiceTokenClaims.description: Shared claims of a voice JWT (HS256, 60 seconds). Call tokens use VOICE_TOKEN_SECRET. A verifier that sees purpose=probe MUST verify with the separate VOICE_PROBE_TOKEN_SECRET, additionally validate ProbeVoiceTokenClaims and compare the receiving node's live registration lease before admitting it. No configured probe key means probe admission is disabled.

srv.description: guild_id, or the DM channel_id for DM calls.

purpose.description: Absent means call. A probe token is restricted to an isolated synthetic room, never an ordinary user channel. It may bypass draining, but never node identity or registration ownership checks.

node_lease.description: Required for probes: exact current etcd registration lease ID as a decimal string. The receiving node must compare it to its live registration before admitting the probe.

probe_id.description: Required for probes: random UUID shared by the two synthetic peers of one run. The server derives the isolated room from node_lease and probe_id, not from the caller's channel ID.

at_server_ms.description: Server clock (unix ms) the position refers to.

WebauthnChallenge.title: WebauthnChallenge
WebauthnChallenge.description: A five-minute, single-use server-side ceremony. Finish requires the same account/session or password-authenticated login ticket.

publicKey.description: WebAuthn PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON or PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON. Binary members use unpadded base64url.

WebauthnLoginFinishRequest.title: WebauthnLoginFinishRequest
WebauthnLoginFinishRequest.description: Complete a passkey assertion. The assertion challenge and login ticket are single use, and the credential signature counter is checked.

WebauthnLoginStartRequest.title: WebauthnLoginStartRequest
WebauthnLoginStartRequest.description: Begin passkey assertion after the password login returned MFA_REQUIRED.

Webhook.title: Webhook
Webhook.description: An incoming, channel-follower or application webhook.

token.description: Execution credential returned only by create and reset-token; never stored in list/get/edit responses.

url.description: Execution URL returned only by create and reset-token. Treat as a secret.
